t: This is the Church of St Alban the Martyr in Golders Green. It was designed by Sir Giles Gilbert Scott, a British architect whose work includes the New Bodleian Library, the Chapel at Charterhouse and Liverpool Cathedral. He also designed Battersea Power Station and the iconic red telephone box. So this church sits alongside some of the best-known buildings and objects in his career. I don't have more detail about the church itself.
